content_sections.heading: GIMS Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the GIMS Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download GIMS Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: GIMS Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 2 for Audiologist /Audiometry Technician, 2 for Speech Therapist/ Speech Language Pathologist and 1 for Assistant Audiologist.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for GIMS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced by GIMS?
faq.answer: Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS) has announced a total of 5 vacancies for the posts of Audiologist / Audiometry Technician and related positions. Candidates are encouraged to check the official notification for a detailed breakdown.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for GIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for this GIMS recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time without any prior online application process.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the GIMS posts?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the recruited candidates is Rs. 40,000 Per Month on a consolidated basis for all the mentioned posts.

faq.question: Q4. What are the educational qualifications required for the GIMS posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post. For Audiologist / Audiometry Technician and Speech Therapist/ Speech Language Pathologist, a B.Sc in Speech and Hearing is required, with M.Sc being desirable. For Assistant Audiologist, a B.Sc. ASLP / Diploma ASLP with experience is needed.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for GIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee of Rs. 1180/- (including GST 18%) for General/OBC and SC/ST categories. Candidates must ensure they pay the fee as per the instructions in the notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for GIMS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process for the GIMS Recruitment 2026 will be based on an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the GIMS located?
faq.answer: The Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS) is located in Greater Noida, Uttar Pradesh.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, category certificate if applicable), and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, this recruitment is being conducted through a Walk-in Interview. There is no online application process. You must attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of GIMS?
faq.answer: The official website of the Government Institute of Medical Sciences (GIMS) is www.gims.ac.in. Candidates can visit this website for more information and updates.
